CC: User Status (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows how to update user status and what happens when offline in the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration (CC) Mobile Application for iOS. |
| :---: |

| Overview: You can easily switch your status between Online and Offline in the mobile app. This helps control your availability for messages.  The color circle on the three (3) line menu indicates your current status.  • Green \= Online • Red \= Offline  | ![][image1] |
| :---- | :---: |
| **How to Change Your Status:** Select the three (3) line menu to expand an additional list of menu options.  Toggle your status appropriately. Set an Auto Response (Optional). Enable the **Auto Response** feature if you want to send a message while offline. Auto responses are **not applied by default**; you must turn them on and set a time frame.  Use this feature to include instructions or details to the sender.  | ![][image2] |
| **What Happens When You Are Offline?** **No Alerts**: You will not receive push notifications or banner alerts. **Message Still Delivered**: Messages will continue to appear in your inbox, waiting to be read. **Urgent Message Override**: Urgent Message Type will override your offline status; alerting will still apply. **System Message to Sender**: A default system message will notify the sender that you are offline. **Auto Response Behavior**: If enabled, auto response will be sent to the sender before the default system message. Auto responses appear like regular messages and can include custom instructions or details. | ![][image3] |
| **Mobile: Messaging an Offline User** A pop-up notification will appear, prompting you to acknowledge that the recipient is currently offline. This helps ensure you are aware that the recipient will not be alerted of your message. | ![][image4] |
